item.title: Major offensive displaces 140,000 civilians in conflict zone
item.description: Heavy fighting and an armed group offensive have displaced 140,000 people, with reports of civilian casualties and deaths mounting.

item.title: Peacekeepers report clashes and ceasefire violations
item.description: UN peacekeeping mission documents fresh clashes between rebel forces, with 2,500 displaced and a humanitarian crisis emerging.

item.title: Attack on village leaves dozens killed
item.description: An attack left at least 45 people killed and many wounded; relief agencies warn of famine risk for refugees.
